title: EBU Stage D prospective completion-oriented continuation records
description: Authority schema only. No campaign, attempt, checkpoint, measurement, scientific outcome, result, or figure is created in this candidate.

prospective_negative_validation_cases.mutation: set sealed_before_stage_f false or outcome_inspected_before_seal true
use attempt ordinal 2 when predecessor ordinal is 0
pair CHECKPOINTED_CONTINUATION_REQUIRED with a scientific disposition
pair CAMPAIGN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED with a positive or negative scientific disposition
set continuation_permitted true for timeout, exhaustion, implementation failure, refusal, deadline, or infeasibility
omit cumulative ledger, stochastic next-counter set, cache epoch, invalidation epoch, authority, code, environment, topology, or exactness identity
use READY with attempt_index 1000000 or TERMINAL_REJECTION_CAP with another attempt_index
decrease a cumulative counter, reset attempt_count, or omit the predecessor ledger identity
count repeated physical bytes as new durable logical allowance
change any result-affecting identity or use suffix_equivalence_verified false
resume without transient classification, unchanged code/environment, proof of no accepted post-checkpoint state, or independent audit
mark infeasibility as scientific evidence or omit independent audit
terminalize while an attempt is active or omit the final campaign resource ledger
enlarge maximum n, subsets, hyperedge order, vertices, edges, depth, horizon, or another non-sliceable problem dimension
continue a partial atomic Möbius, poset, canonical, or exact-case operation
permit silent approximation, truncation, sampling, topology alteration, or arbitrary-N completion
omit, duplicate, or lose a terminal attempt delta; omit a latest run ledger; or make completion order affect the campaign aggregate
